zh.title: 哦,荣耀神圣爱
zh.summary: 亚特兰大的一次聚会唱诗，众人围坐弹唱英文诗歌《O Glorious Divine Love》。

en.title: O Glorious Divine Love
en.summary: A gathering in Atlanta to sing “O Glorious Divine Love,” a hymn celebrating God’s love.

zh: 自久未创世界以先，
祢心就渴望一配偶；
彼此为居所，荣耀安排；
与我永世联属。
不知祢心所愿，我犯罪当诛灭；
而祢流宝血使我得释。
赐我祢生命，使我亲近祢；
奇妙爱！我两永世合为一。
哦，荣耀神圣爱！我如何测度，
比天空更高，比洋海更深;
冲破死权势，和撒旦国度；
无何与比拟，祢爱情于我，
如此热烈深挚，如此温柔真实;
我深深爱祢,主。
我给祢我心，我命与我魂，
无论是苦楚，或喜乐来临，
祢无限恩典，我放下所有，
建造祢召会，祢荣耀新妇。
使祢心得满足，我们互为居所，
在永世里。
en: Since long before the world began,
In Your heart You longed for a Bride;
’Tis mutual dwelling, Your glorious plan;
With me e’er to abide.
Not knowing Your heart,
I sinned and thus should die;
Yet You shed Your blood to set me free.
You gave me Your life, to me drew nigh;
Wondrous love! We two one forever will be.
O glorious divine love! How can I fathom,
Higher than the sky, deeper than the sea;
It crushes death’s pow’r and Satan’s kingdom;
Nothing can compare with Your love to me
So fervid and so deep, so gentle and so true;
I’m in love, Lord, with You.
I give You my heart, my life and my soul,
Come suffering or joy whatever betide.
By Your boundless grace, I’ll lay down my all
To build up Your church, Your glorious Bride;
Your heart to satisfy, mutual abode we’ll be
In eternity.

zh.title: 日子像钟摆，来回都是无聊？
zh.summary: 上班觉得空，放假又无聊。李光弘用一个钟摆的比喻，聊聊我们到底在为什么而活。

en.title: Is Life Just Back and Forth?
en.summary: Work feels empty. Time off gets boring. Livingstone Lee asks whether life has to swing between the two.

zh.title: 吃穿不愁，心里还缺什么？
zh.summary: 生活的需要，不只有吃饱和过好。李光弘从人的内在需要，聊到信仰带来的另一种可能。

en.title: What Are We Still Missing?
en.summary: Food, comfort and a good life matter. But what about the needs we cannot see? A conversation about our inner life and faith.

zh.title: 2026年7月28日｜李光弘在亚特兰大分享福音
zh.summary: 李光弘从宇宙的秩序、人生的追求与《传道书》谈起，分享人在日光之下为何感到虚空，以及福音所带来的盼望。

en.title: Livingstone Lee Shares the Gospel in Atlanta | July 28, 2026
en.summary: Livingstone Lee reflects on the order of the universe, the search for meaning, and Ecclesiastes—asking why life “under the sun” can feel empty and where lasting hope is found.

zh: “天也空，地也空，人生渺茫在其中。”
“日光之下是虚空的虚空，如捕风。”
en: “Heaven and earth are empty; life is fleeting among them.”
“Vanity of vanities; all is vanity under the sun, like chasing the wind.”

zh.title: 一张福音单张，怎样走进一个家庭？
zh.summary: 一张在公交车上收下的福音单张，被母亲发现后，让一家四口一起去听福音。李光弘回忆这段改变家庭方向的往事。

en.title: How One Flyer Reached a Family
en.summary: A leaflet accepted on a bus was found by a mother—and led a family of four to hear the gospel together. Livingstone Lee recalls the moment that changed his family’s direction.

sourceNote.zh: 选自王生台夫妇《我为何存在》录像。为完整呈现“经历—提问—回应”，组合原片 00:02.67–01:15.35、01:43.79–04:40.85，结尾接回 01:15.35–01:43.79 的回应。保留讲述者原声，未添加配音。
sourceNote.en: From Why Do I Exist?, a recording by Wang Shengtai and Wang Jialing. This edit combines source times 00:02.67–01:15.35 and 01:43.79–04:40.85, closing with her response at 01:15.35–01:43.79. Original speech retained; no added narration.

zh.title: 坐进人生的头等舱，却不知道飞往哪里？
zh.summary: 家庭、学业和前途都很顺利，她却追问人生的方向。王嘉玲用“飞机头等舱”的比喻讲述自己的经历，并以主动认识造她的主，回应这个追问。

en.title: First Class in Life—But Where Is It Going?
en.summary: With a loving family, academic success and a promising future, Wang Jialing still questioned her direction. Her first-class-flight analogy leads to her response: actively seeking her Creator.
